name: gitops
description: Safe git subset: status/diff/log/branch reads run directly; add, commit, push, pull, checkout, stash, merge, reset and clean are state-changing and pass through ISHTI's T2 confirmation gate with the exact command shown. Never force-push, never hard-reset to a remote state without the gate.
route: git status, git log, git diff, show branches, commit my changes, push to origin, pull the repo, stash my changes, which branch am I on
